entities.summary: Stamford Raffles, a notable figure in the history of Singapore, associated with Founding of Modern Singapore (1819–1826). Preceded by Raffles and the Free Port and Stamford Raffles establishes a British trading post at Singapore. Their legacy influenced East India Company and Singapore becomes a Crown Colony directly under the Colonial Office.
